stock.note: Draw pile. Server shuffles and deals from here.

discard.note: Discard pile. Top card visible to both players.

hand.note: Player hand. Holds 10 cards normally, 11 after drawing before discarding.

melds.note: Revealed melds after knocking. Used for lay-off resolution.

score.note: Cumulative score across hands. Game to 100 points.

card.note: Standard 52-card deck. Ace low (value 1). Face cards worth 10 for deadwood.

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Shuffle deck, deal 10 cards each, turn one card face-up to start discard pile.

phases.name: play
phases.note: Each turn: draw one card (from stock or top of discard), then discard one card. Player may knock if deadwood <= 10 or declare gin if deadwood == 0.

phases.name: knock
phases.note: Knocker reveals melds and deadwood. Opponent may lay off unmatched cards on knocker's melds (unless gin). Scores computed.

draw.definition: Draw exactly one card from stock or top of discard pile

discard.definition: Discard exactly one card from hand to discard pile

knock.definition: Declare knock when deadwood value <= 10 after discarding

gin.definition: Declare gin when all 10 cards form melds (deadwood == 0)

lay_off.definition: Opponent may extend knocker's melds with matching cards from their own hand
lay_off.note: Cannot lay off if knocker declared gin.

undercut.definition: If opponent's deadwood <= knocker's deadwood, opponent scores the difference plus 25 bonus

stock_exhaustion.definition: If stock has 2 cards remaining and no knock, hand is void (no score)

library.deadwood: sum of rank_value for cards not in any meld
library.meld_set: 3 or 4 cards of the same rank (different suits)
library.meld_run: 3 or more consecutive cards of the same suit (ace low)
